title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Ancient Cave (Maze Section)
description:
A very unusual and weird background seen in a short maze section of the Ancient Cave, from the Super Famicom version of Popful Mail. Could fit some cave levels or maybe an alien-themed level due to the bizarre nature of the background. Uses only A tiles, meaning there is a lot of space in the for foreground decoration.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
